definition: A thing is in act in a perfection, inclusively, when it is in act in it formally (DEF-IN-ACT-FORMALLY) or virtually (DEF-IN-ACT-VIRTUALLY): the disjunction ActFrame.InActBy .formallyOrVirtually. It is weaker than formal act as a property of a mover, and as the act predicate of non-simultaneity it gives a stronger premise.
note: Analyst sense, attribution deferred; ST I q.4 a.2 co. ('univoce vel eminentius') is navigation for it, not a pinned claim. Sourcing would need a claim that reads a prima via act premise disjunctively.
